name: UJAM Symphonic Elements
help: Phrase player (STRIIIINGS / BRAAASS): this musician holds the chord in the Play Range (C3–B4) and the root in Bass Notes (C2–B2), picks a Style Phrase key (C1–A1) from Energy, fires Additions at phrase ends and rides the mod wheel. Its own patterns are not used. Turn Latch off in UJAM.
